item.title: National Park Service drops free admission on MLK Day, Juneteenth while adding Trump’s birthday
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The National Park Service will offer free admission to U.S. residents on President Donald Trump’s birthday next year — which also happens to be Flag Day — but is eliminating the benefit for Martin Luther King Jr. Day and Juneteenth. item.title: Man wounded in second stabbing attack on North Carolina commuter train since August
